dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, crenulated 'O' and 'C' shaped light borders located on the posterior dorsal region, showing a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity light perimeters to darker interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized light-colored pixel clusters on the posterior third of the body, characterized by high-intensity cores without internal color gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent posterior macro-annuli form an asymmetrical quadrilateral with its longest axis parallel to the spine.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, nearly saturated high-intensity white zone at the extreme posterior terminus, distinct from the smaller localized annuli patterns.
